messages:
alex: FYI p95 spike on hosted-edge us-west-2 started ~5m ago, queue depth climbing from 20->200. seeing kernel fallbacks and slow batching. blaming noisy shard? :eyes:

maria: grabbing traces, can you post tiny profiler output? is KV cache hitrate dropping?

alex: quick metrics: p95 480ms -> 1.8s, p99 1.2s -> 4.6s. queue depth heatmap attached (snippet below). KV cache hit rate on the hot shard dropped from 94% -> 43% around 2399991210.

alex: ```
edge_queue_depth: 21, 45, 120, 200
kvcache_hit: 0.94 -> 0.43
active_kernels: ff_kernel x3, aux_kernel x2 -> aux_kernelFallback x6
```

sam: aux_kernelFallback indicates kernel selection changed under pressure. did a recent rollout of q4-ranged kernels? check kernel selector logs. also check per-tenant concurrency caps — rate cap could be queuing.

maria: profiler dump (sampling 5s) - showing long tail in batch coalescer wait: ```
coalescer_wait_ms: 2,3,120,450,532
batch_sizes: 1,1,2,2,64,1,1
KV priming ops: spike @2399991208 (priming 81 reqs)
```

oncall: infra-bot shows a small deploy finished at 2399991188 to model routing service (deploy-id: deploy-2026-03-18-17). could be config flip that changed kernel preference. tagging infra for correlation.

infra-bot: Deploy deploy-2026-03-18-17 completed on cluster us-west-2-edge. 6/6 hosts updated. Routing config change: "prefer_aux_for_lowcost": true.

sam: that routing flag would push more requests to aux kernels (cheaper) -> if aux kernels underprovisioned for latency, they'll push to fallback and cause queuing. we should: 1) flip flag, 2) bump aux kernel threads on hot hosts, 3) prime KV cache for hot prefix.

maria: agree. quick remediation: flip routing flag to previous value and trigger KV cache prefill for top-20 prefixes from recent trace.

alex: I'm toggling flag now. running: ```sh
curl -XPOST $ROUTER/admin/flags -d '{"prefer_aux_for_lowcost": false}'
```

alex: flag flipped at 2399991238. monitoring...

maria: triggering KV prefill job for hot tenant list (script below).

maria: ```sh
python tools/prefill_kvcache.py --cluster us-west-2-edge --tenants-file hot_tenants.txt --parallel 8
```

alex: after flip, p95 down to ~600ms in 30s, queue depth trending down (200 -> 40). KV hitrate rising slowly. :thumbsup:

oncall: leaving this thread but will watch for recurrence. if we see reappearance, escalate to perf oncall.

sam: follow-up actions: 1) rollback flag to defaults in infra config repo (PR #412), 2) add safety check to router to limit aux assignment when KV hitrate < 60%, 3) add coalescer metrics alert for batch wait > 200ms, 4) plan a canary for routing flags.

alex: created PR for flag rollback and alerts. p95 stabilizing at 320-450ms. closing for now but will add short RCA note to incidents.

maria: leaving a profiling artifact link: https://perf.redwood/investigations/2399991234/trace1

oncall: thanks all. :white_check_mark:
